description: The agent must: (1) Read project_data.json with raw dimension scores. (2) Apply the exact 6-dimension weighted scoring matrix from SKILL.md (市场需求度=25%, 技术创新性=20%, 技术成熟度=20%, 竞争优势=15%, 团队匹配度=10%, 资源可获得性=10%) to compute 9×0.20+8×0.25+7×0.20+8×0.15+6×0.10+5×0.10=7.50 → 75.0/100, NOT the naive equal-weight average of 71.7. The score >70 maps to '强烈推荐转化'. (3) Apply the exact funding formula: 230000 × 8 × 1.5 = 2,760,000 yuan (must include the 1.5 safety factor from SKILL.md; naive calculation without 1.5 gives 1,840,000 which is wrong). 276万 falls in 种子轮 range (50-300万). (4) Evaluate KPIs: CAC=15000 < LTV/3=17333 → healthy; LTV=52000 > CAC×3=45000 → healthy; MAU growth 23.5% → healthy; B2B retention=38% < 40% threshold → UNHEALTHY (this is the critical trap — general knowledge might accept 38% as fine, but SKILL.md explicitly requires >40% for B2B); NPS=34 > 30 → healthy. Output must be saved as startup_assessment.json.
